SCM 챗봇 PoC.title: SCM Natural-Language Query Chatbot PoC — Answer-Accuracy Study
SCM 챗봇 PoC.description: A chatbot where a local LLM turns Korean SCM questions into SQL / clarify / refuse, the server validates it, and it runs on a read-only account to answer. The real deliverable is not the UI but the accuracy-measurement system and improvement record.
highlights: Evaluation first: golden set frozen with SHA-256, graded by execution result value (reproducible at temperature 0 · seed 42). The grader itself verified at 30/30 by injecting correct answers.
Cause classification → knowledge injection: baseline 7/30 → adding a reference date, metric dictionary and examples reached 22/30 on the basic set (period aggregation 0/8 → 7/8).
Core improvement: moved metric calculation that prompts could not fix into server fixed-queries (tools) + a router → frozen holdout of 20 items 13 → 16, all tool-path metric questions correct (7/7).

Honest record: kept the SQL-validation/retry version even though it dropped; confirmed by measurement that 100% number post-verification pass does not equal correctness. Independent code review and red-teaming in parallel.
